caveats:
2018 12 27

Replacement boundaries added

2018 10 26 update:
Administrative level 0 shapefile added.

**Languages:** EN

Based on 2016  shapefiles / kml from the [South African Municipal Demarcation Board](http://www.demarcation.org.za/) website  under:   http://www.demarcation.org.za/site/shapefiles/

Data includes new Local Municipality names added in 2016.

name: cod-ab-zaf
notes:
South Africa administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 9 Province  
- Admin 2: 52 District  
- Admin 3: 213 Local municipality  
- Admin 4: 4392   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 28 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 09 November 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 27 December 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 27 December 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
